name: Leesburg
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Leesburg, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Leesburg, Florida for 2026: the Christmas Festival and parade, Venetian Gardens lights, library programs and a holiday show.
lede: Leesburg celebrates with a downtown Christmas Festival and 59th parade, a Venetian Gardens light up on the lake and library and theater programs.
celebrates: Leesburg's Christmas season centers on the Towne Square and Venetian Gardens. Light Up Venetian Gardens and the Leesburg Christmas on the Water boat parade are on Sunday, December 6, and the Christmas Festival and 59th Annual Christmas Parade fill downtown on Saturday, December 12, with a festival at 1 pm and a parade at 6 pm. Melon Patch Players stage Every Christmas Story Ever Told, and Leesburg Public Library holds an ornament workshop, A Christmas Carol and Christmas at Fire Station 61.
lastyear: The 2025 Leesburg Christmas Festival and Parade was promoted by the City of Leesburg as a day of live music, free ice skating, kids activities, vendors, food and visits with Santa, according to a Florida Festivals and Events Association listing. In 2026 the festival and the 59th Annual Christmas Parade return to Towne Square and Main Street on Saturday, December 12, with the festival at 1 pm and the parade at 6 pm.
facts: The 2026 Leesburg parade is its 59th annual, which dates the first one to 1968. The Light Up Venetian Gardens evening is followed by a lighted boat parade run by the Leesburg Boat Club on the lake, according to its event listing. Melon Patch Players present Every Christmas Story Ever Told at the Melon Patch Theatre on December 18 and 19, and the library's Christmas at Fire Station 61 is a December 16 program.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Leesburg itself, and we only list rides we can verify on a host page. Our Florida Christmas train rides guide collects the closest holiday train rides across the state for a longer day out. Eustis, a short drive away, has a trackless train for kids at Festive Friday in Ferran on December 11, according to the city's event page.
traditions: A downtown festival at 1 pm and a parade at 6 pm on December 12.
A light up at Ski Beach Park at 6 pm.
A lighted holiday boat parade run by the Leesburg Boat Club.
A holiday comedy at the Melon Patch Theatre.
Ornaments, A Christmas Carol and Christmas at Fire Station 61.
kidfact: The Leesburg Christmas parade is on its 59th year, so it has been rolling down Main Street since 1968.
faq: With Light Up Venetian Gardens and a boat parade on December 6, the Christmas Festival and 59th parade on December 12, a Melon Patch Players holiday show and library programs.
When is the Leesburg Christmas Parade?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 6 pm, with the Christmas Festival at 1 pm, in downtown Leesburg.
Where are the Venetian Gardens lights?
At Ski Beach Park in Venetian Gardens, with the boat parade on the lake after dark on December 6.
Are there library programs in Leesburg?
Yes, Leesburg Public Library holds an ornament workshop, A Christmas Carol, Christmas at Fire Station 61 and Santa Story Time.
Is there a Christmas show in Leesburg?
Yes, Melon Patch Players present Every Christmas Story Ever Told, a ticketed show, at the Melon Patch Theatre.
